'''Tholothians''' were the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tholoth/Legends|Tholoth]]. [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]], both members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], were Tholothians, although Gallia's [[Parent/Legends|parents]], both [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], were born on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] was also a Tholothian.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Katooni-TCWs5BR1.png|thumb|left|120px|Katooni, a Tholothian youngling.]]
Tholothians were seemingly ageless<ref name="TCW H2H">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head]]''</ref> [[Near-Human]]s from [[Tholoth/Legends|Tholoth]]. They were dark-skinned, often with blue or indigo-[[Color/Legends|colored]] eyes.
